_about: SYNTHETIC test registry for the CMU/Emeritus capstone: one entry per test with its detection words, its procedure (docs_extended/), the inputs the procedure requires (chat questions and Check quality rules both come from these), and the sample minimum. Regexes are matched case-insensitively on the request text. 'when' limits an input to board-mounted or wire-terminated parts.

tests.name: mechanical force test on a universal testing machine (mating/unmating, retention, crimp pull-out or normal force)
tests.example: Instron mating and unmating force on 10 SYN-20001 connectors

inputs.question: Which force test: mating and unmating (insertion and withdrawal) force, contact or terminal retention, crimp pull-out, or contact normal force?
inputs.missing: The type of force test is not stated.
inputs.example: mating and unmating force

inputs.question: Where and how is the force applied: along which axis, how is the sample held (fixture, board, clamp), and is the mating half supplied (part number)?
inputs.missing: How the sample is held and where the force is applied is not stated.
inputs.example: held by the board in a fixture, force along the mating axis, mating half SYN-20002 supplied

inputs.question: At what speed (mm/min) and to what end point (full mating, a set distance, or until separation or failure)?
inputs.missing: Test speed and end point are not stated.
inputs.example: 25 mm/min, until fully mated

inputs.question: What are the acceptance limits (for example maximum mating force and minimum unmating force in N, or minimum retention force)?
inputs.missing: No force acceptance limits.
inputs.example: mating 60 N max, unmating 10 N min

tests.name: durability (repeated mating and unmating cycles)
tests.example: Durability, 50 mating cycles on 5 SYN-20001 connectors with LLCR before and after

inputs.question: How many mating cycles, and at what rate (cycles per minute)?
inputs.missing: The number of cycles is not stated.
inputs.example: 50 cycles at 10 cycles per minute

inputs.question: Is the mating half supplied (part number), and how are both halves held and aligned?
inputs.missing: The mating half or how the halves are held is not stated.
inputs.example: mating half SYN-20002 supplied; both on test boards in an alignment fixture

inputs.question: What is measured before, during and after cycling (for example LLCR or mating force at 0, 25 and 50 cycles)?
inputs.missing: Readouts before and after cycling are not stated.
inputs.example: LLCR and unmating force at 0 and 50 cycles

inputs.question: What are the acceptance limits after cycling (for example resistance change in milliohms, force change, no visible wear through the plating)?
inputs.missing: No acceptance limits after cycling.
inputs.example: max 10 mOhm change, no wear through the gold

tests.name: SEM inspection with EDS element analysis
tests.example: SEM and EDS on 2 failed SYN-20001 contacts to find the contamination on the contact area

inputs.question: What question should the analysis answer (for example identify a contamination, check a plating defect, look at a fracture, compare with a good part)?
inputs.missing: The question the analysis should answer is not stated.
inputs.example: identify the dark residue on the contact area

inputs.question: Where on the part: which feature or area should be examined? Mark it on a drawing or photo and list that file under Attachments.
inputs.answered: contact area|mating area|\btip\b|\bbarrel\b|solder (joint|fillet)|fracture surface|marked|arrow|see (the )?(photo|drawing|picture)|\.(jpg|jpeg|png|pdf)\b|position \d|pin \d|area of interest|region
inputs.missing: The area to examine is not stated or marked.
inputs.example: dark spot on the contact area of position 5, marked in photo1.jpg

inputs.question: Is EDS element analysis needed, and which elements matter (for example S, Cl, Sn, Ni)?
inputs.missing: EDS and the elements of interest are not stated.
inputs.example: EDS for S, Cl and Ni

inputs.question: May the lab cut, section or coat the samples (destructive), or must they stay intact? Is a good reference part supplied?
inputs.answered: destructive|may (be )?(cut|section|coat)|must stay intact|keep intact|do not (cut|destroy)|reference (part|sample)|good part
inputs.missing: Whether the samples may be cut or coated is not stated.
inputs.example: may be sectioned; one good part supplied as reference

tests.name: FTIR material or residue identification
tests.example: FTIR to identify the residue on 3 SYN-10001 housings

inputs.question: What should be identified: the bulk material (resin), a surface residue or contamination, or a comparison between two lots?
inputs.missing: What to identify is not stated.
inputs.example: the white residue on the housing surface

inputs.question: Where should the sample be taken: which part and which area or feature? Mark it on a drawing or photo and list that file under Attachments.
inputs.missing: Where to take the sample is not stated.
inputs.example: white residue on the top face near the latch, marked in photo2.jpg

inputs.question: Is a reference supplied (a known-good part, the resin pellets, or the expected material and its datasheet)?
inputs.missing: No reference material or expected material.
inputs.example: resin pellets from the same lot supplied; expected LCP

tests.name: plating porosity test (acid vapor exposure)
tests.example: Porosity on 5 SYN-20001 contacts, gold over nickel

inputs.question: What is the plating (layers and minimum thicknesses, for example 0.76 µm gold over 1.27 µm nickel)?
inputs.missing: The plating layers and thicknesses are not stated.
inputs.example: 0.76 µm Au over 1.27 µm Ni

inputs.question: Which surfaces are evaluated (for example the contact area within 1 mm of the mating point), and how is that area marked?
inputs.missing: The surfaces to evaluate are not stated.
inputs.example: contact area within 1 mm of the mating point, per drawing

inputs.question: Which method: acid vapor exposure (default) or another method named in your specification?
inputs.missing: The porosity method is not stated (the lab uses acid vapor).
inputs.example: acid vapor exposure

inputs.question: What is the acceptance limit (for example no more than N pores per contact area)?
inputs.missing: No pore-count limit.
inputs.example: max 2 pores per contact area

tests.name: cross-section (microsection) with optical inspection
tests.example: Cross-section of 3 SYN-20001 solder joints on the test board

inputs.question: Where to section: which location (contact, joint or feature) and in which plane (for example through position 5, parallel to the mating axis)? A marked drawing or photo helps.
inputs.missing: The section location and plane are not stated.
inputs.example: through position 5, parallel to the mating axis

inputs.question: What should be measured or inspected on the section (plating thickness, solder fillet and voids, crimp compaction, cracks)?
inputs.missing: What to measure on the section is not stated.
inputs.example: solder fillet height and voids

inputs.question: How many sections per sample, and may the lab pot (encapsulate) the samples?
inputs.missing: Number of sections per sample is not stated.
inputs.example: one section per sample, potting allowed

tests.name: plating thickness measurement by X-ray fluorescence (XRF)
tests.example: XRF plating thickness on 5 SYN-20001 contacts

inputs.question: Which layers and what specification (for example Au 0.76 µm min over Ni 1.27 µm min)?
inputs.missing: The layers and their specification are not stated.
inputs.example: Au 0.76 µm min over Ni 1.27 µm min

inputs.question: Where to measure: which spots on the contact (for example the contact area and the tail) and how many points per sample?
inputs.missing: The measurement spots are not stated.
inputs.example: contact area of positions 1, 10 and 20, 3 points each

inputs.question: Should the results be judged against the specification minimums, or only reported?
inputs.missing: It is not stated whether to judge against the specification.
inputs.example: judge against the drawing minimums

tests.name: thermal analysis of a material (DSC, TMA or TGA)
tests.example: DSC on resin from 2 SYN-10001 housings to check the melting point

inputs.question: Which property: glass transition (Tg), melting or crystallisation, coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE), decomposition, or degree of cure?
inputs.missing: The property to measure is not stated.
inputs.example: melting point and crystallisation

inputs.question: Where is the sample taken from: which part and which area (for example the bulk resin near the gate, or pellets)?
inputs.missing: Where the sample is taken is not stated.
inputs.example: bulk resin cut from the side wall

inputs.question: Over what temperature range, at what heating rate, and in which atmosphere (for example 25 to 350 °C at 10 °C/min in nitrogen)?
inputs.missing: Temperature range, heating rate and atmosphere are not stated.
inputs.example: 25 to 350 °C at 10 °C/min in nitrogen

inputs.question: Where to indent: which location and surface (for example the contact spring arm, on a polished cross-section or on the surface)?
inputs.missing: The indentation location is not stated.
inputs.example: on a cross-section of the spring arm, mid-thickness

inputs.question: Which scale and load (for example HV 0.1), and how many indents per sample?
inputs.missing: Scale, load and number of indents are not stated.
inputs.example: HV 0.1, 5 indents per sample

inputs.question: What is the specification (for example 180 to 230 HV for the base metal temper)?
inputs.missing: No hardness specification.
inputs.example: 180 to 230 HV

tests.name: dielectric withstanding voltage (DWV) and insulation resistance
tests.example: DWV and insulation resistance on 5 SYN-20001 connectors

inputs.question: What test voltage (AC or DC, in volts or kV) and for how long (for example 1000 V AC for 60 s; insulation resistance at 500 V DC)?
inputs.missing: The test voltage and duration are not stated.
inputs.example: 750 V AC for 60 s; IR at 500 V DC

inputs.question: Between which points: adjacent contacts, every contact to the shell, or contacts to ground? Which positions?
inputs.missing: The points the voltage is applied between are not stated.
inputs.example: between adjacent contacts and every contact to the shell

inputs.question: What are the limits (maximum leakage current, for example 5 mA; minimum insulation resistance, for example 5000 MΩ)?
inputs.missing: No leakage or insulation-resistance limits.
inputs.example: leakage 5 mA max; IR 5000 MOhm min

inputs.question: In which condition: mated or unmated, and before or after an exposure such as humidity?
inputs.missing: The sample condition (mated/unmated, after which exposure) is not stated.
inputs.example: mated, as received and after humidity
